prioritization_heuristic: min(abs(real effect),abs(mean5seed model effect))*fraction5seed signs agreeing with real*real leave-one-donor sign agreement; zero unless >=4/5 seeds,>=80% of40replicates,>=80% real donor deletion checks and the5seed mean direction agree. Exploratory effect-size heuristic; no significance or causal claim.
limitations: One33-donor optimization fold; age,sex,genotype and other covariates are not causally controlled.
Generated subtype assignments use a training-only classifier and may be inaccurate.
HVG filtering omits many actionable risk genes; absence is not evidence of absence.
Model predictions describe observational stage conditions; they do not simulate genes,drugs,doses or intervention response.
Candidate and intervention direction require external primary perturbation evidence and subsequent wet-lab testing.
